meta.one_line_verdict_ko: Texas recovery·asset sales·EPS normalization이 현실화돼 $27.50 부근 entry의 $37 target를 2005말 달성
meta.key_mechanism: regulatory cash recovery and noncore asset sales reduced balance-sheet risk and restored a utility valuation regime

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: 낮은 ha당 자산가치와 mature-yield growth thesis는 장기 net cash/earnings 축적으로 검증; SQL return은 wrong-company contamination으로 폐기
meta.key_mechanism: cheap planted hectares plus maturation of already-developed acreage compounded production and asset value across commodity cycles

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: 2022 C$100m revenue target는 실패했지만 roll-up platform은 성장했고 C$1 target는 2023~24 지연 달성
meta.key_mechanism: regional transport/permitting moats and fragmented succession-driven M&A created value, but acquisition cadence was overestimated

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: C$1.50 target는 2024 지연 달성했지만 2022 C$17m EBIT annualization은 peak-cycle denominator를 과대평가
meta.key_mechanism: very low entry multiple and platform optionality survived a housing-cycle earnings reset, but record-quarter annualization overstated normalized EBIT

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: GFC로 near-term timing은 흔들렸지만 distressed acquisitions와 consolidation이 장기 value를 키워 2017 $110 strategic exit로 검증
meta.key_mechanism: balance-sheet resilience converted recession stress into cheap asset acquisitions while buybacks concentrated normalized earnings per share

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: Atlantis acquisition economics와 normalized value thesis는 성공했지만 $74~99의 1~2년 target timing은 과도
meta.key_mechanism: distressed acquisition price plus synergies and debt paydown created much more normalized EBITDA than headline purchase value implied

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: depressed EBIT/lb normalization과 aggressive buyback thesis가 장기 strategic value로 이어져 2017 $110 transaction으로 검증
meta.key_mechanism: normalized unit margins combined with a materially lower share count amplified per-share earnings power

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: $9.40 stand-alone EPS는 acquisition으로 직접 미검증이지만 trough earnings normalization과 consolidation value는 $110 strategic exit로 강하게 검증
meta.key_mechanism: capacity times normalized spread, reinforced by buybacks and consolidation, revealed earning power far above trough reported EBITDA

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: medium-term FCF와 주가는 개선됐지만 C$24 target 실패; 2017 Air Canada non-renewal이 anchor-partner dependency를 드러냄
meta.key_mechanism: capital-light loyalty cash flow was real, but network utility depended more heavily on the Air Canada anchor than aggregate member counts suggested

meta.one_line_verdict_ko: 2016 EPS $5.50 예상이 실제 $5.52로 거의 정확했지만 2Y price -18.4%; earnings forecast와 valuation-regime forecast가 분리돼야 함
meta.key_mechanism: ILFC delivered the modeled earnings accretion, but persistent leverage/residual-value risk kept the market multiple below the thesis assumption

batch_lessons: Ticker identity must be audited before any price-performance calculation; AEP and AER each contained materially different companies under the same symbol.
When company mapping is wrong, the associated performance row must be rejected rather than mechanically reused.
Utility turnarounds can rerate through regulatory cash recovery and balance-sheet risk normalization without requiring high growth.
Plantation assets are better understood through EV per hectare, tree-age profile and yield per hectare than through a single current-year P/E.
Roll-up forecasts should not annualize an acquisition pipeline or a record quarter as if cadence and margins were guaranteed.
Spread businesses should be modeled through units times normalized spread, not noisy revenue that moves with raw-material prices.
AEPI shows how downturn balance sheets, distressed acquisitions and buybacks can compound per-share value across a cycle.
A strategic takeout can validate terminal value without proving an earlier target-price horizon or an unobserved EPS forecast.
Coalition-network durability depends on the topology of critical partners, not just member counts or gross billings diversification.
AerCap demonstrates that a nearly perfect earnings forecast can still produce a poor stock call when the assumed valuation multiple does not arrive.
Numerator and multiple are separate hypotheses and should receive separate falsifiers and post-mortems.
